cases.name: read
cases.deviation: upstream `document.settings` adds a default settings part as a side effect of reading; Rust reads `false` without creating a part

cases.name: set-true-creates-part
cases.deviation: upstream re-serializes every part it loads without inter-element whitespace (remove_blank_text), so the pretty-printed core, styles and document parts of this Behave file change semantically; Rust keeps them. m7-inherited-settings-no-part-compact repeats the case on a blank-text-free copy and passes

cases.name: set-false-creates-part
cases.deviation: upstream re-serializes every part it loads without inter-element whitespace (remove_blank_text), so the pretty-printed core, styles and document parts of this Behave file change semantically; Rust keeps them. m7-inherited-settings-no-part-compact repeats the case on a blank-text-free copy and passes
